title: The Three Bases a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Level Arrives at Its Fee On
content:
The basis the protection fee is arrived at on is the level's own, and the three bases are not
interchangeable. The trip price is the daily rate locked in on the trip taken for each of the reserved days,
read from the Keyturn Trip Booking the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election belongs to.

1. Where the level the election stands on arrives at its fee as the greater of its daily amount and its share of
   the trip price, the fee is the greater of the level's daily amount for the charged days and the level's share
   of the trip price.
2. Where the level arrives at its fee as a share of the trip price, the fee is the level's share of the trip
   price.
3. Where the level arrives at its fee as a daily flat amount, the fee is the level's daily amount for the
   charged days.

The share of the trip price each level is written at:

| The level the election stands on | Share of the trip price |
|---|---|
| Keyturn Declined Protection | 0 percent |
| Keyturn Minimum Protection | 15 percent |
| Keyturn Standard Protection | 25 percent |
| Keyturn Advantage Protection | 35 percent |
| Keyturn Premier Protection | 45 percent |
| Keyturn Business Traveler Protection | 40 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Take a hypothetical trip whose locked-in daily rate is 90.00 USD over 8 reserved days, so the trip price is
720.00 USD, and an election carrying 8 charged days.

- On a level written at a daily amount of 26.00 USD and a share of 25 percent, arriving at its fee as the
  greater of the two: the daily amount for the charged days is 208.00 USD and the share of the trip price is
  180.00 USD, so the greater of the two, 208.00 USD, is taken.
- On a level written at a daily amount of 14.00 USD and a share of 15 percent, arriving at its fee as the
  greater of the two: the daily amount for the charged days is 112.00 USD and the share of the trip price is
  108.00 USD, so 112.00 USD is taken.
- On a level arriving at its fee as a share of the trip price alone and written at 45 percent, the fee is
  324.00 USD however many charged days there are.
- On a level arriving at its fee as a daily flat amount of 64.00 USD, the fee is 512.00 USD for those 8 charged
  days and the trip price does not enter it.
